capabilities: Toggle CSS snippets from the command palette
Apply snippet changes without restarting or reloading
disambiguation: Not a text-snippet or template tool; it only toggles CSS appearance snippets from the command palette.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author found the Settings navigation path for toggling snippets annoying when using many snippets or switching them frequently.
problem: Enabling or disabling a CSS snippet requires navigating through Settings > Appearance and scrolling to find it, which is tedious when switching snippets often.
summary: Command-palette utility that toggles CSS snippets on and off without opening Settings.
